svg.title: Use case diagram 2 — Institution staff (Institution portal)

g.text: Use case diagram 2 — Institution staff (Institution portal)
What each staff member can do comes from their roles (RBAC) and is checked on every API call;
the Owner / staff split drawn here is the template roles' default, not a fixed rule.
Owner gets the cloned OWNER role on approval; other roles are made by the institution and can only
hold permissions their maker holds (anti-escalation). A switched-off module removes its use cases.
